purpose: Stage 2 candidate Template list (conventions v1.0 section 2). Each template is defined by the structural signatures it accepts. Sources are assigned by tools/stage2_cluster.py; source-specific exceptions live in assignment_overrides with a reason. Draft for user review; nothing here is a built template yet.

templates.name: Variable distribution summary
templates.intended_use: Summarise one or more variables at a single reference point: continuous variables as descriptive-statistic rows, categorical variables as exhaustive category rows with n (%), optional missing row.
templates.not_for: Per-visit summaries (TBL_PARAMETER_BY_VISIT); non-exclusive criterion/flag rows (TBL_CRITERION_COUNTS); dictionary-coded terms (TBL_CODED_TERM_HIERARCHY).
candidate_config_options: statistic row set incl. geometric mean / CV%

templates.name: Subject counts by criterion
templates.intended_use: Rows are predefined criteria or status flags (disposition status and reasons, analysis-set membership, deviation categories, deaths and causes, AE overview flags, DLT, ADA status, clinically notable thresholds); each row counts subjects meeting that criterion; rows need not be mutually exclusive and may be nested.
templates.not_for: Distribution of a variable over exhaustive categories (TBL_VARIABLE_SUMMARY); coded dictionary terms (TBL_CODED_TERM_HIERARCHY).

templates.name: Coded term hierarchy summary
templates.intended_use: Subject (and optionally event) counts by dictionary-coded terms: SOC/PT, ATC class/preferred name, AESI category/PT, SMQ/PT or PT only; data-driven rows with an 'any' row and a sort rule.
templates.not_for: Predefined categories not coming from a coding dictionary (TBL_CRITERION_COUNTS).
candidate_config_options: category split (grade / severity / relationship) as sub-rows or sub-columns

templates.name: Parameter by visit summary
templates.intended_use: For each parameter, repeat a block per visit/timepoint: continuous descriptive statistics (optionally with change from baseline) or categorical n (%) (including threshold categories at baseline / worst post-baseline).
templates.not_for: Statistics laid out as columns (TBL_TIMEPOINT_STATISTICS_COLUMNS); baseline x post-baseline cross-classification (TBL_SHIFT_CROSSTAB).

templates.name: Timepoint summary with statistics in columns
templates.intended_use: Rows are timepoints (e.g. PK nominal times, visits) within analyte/parameter blocks; columns are statistics (n, Mean (SD), Median, Min, Max, geometric mean, CV%); groups on row blocks or repeated pages.
candidate_config_options: statistic column set incl. geometric statistics

templates.name: Shift / cross-classification table
templates.intended_use: Cross-classify subjects by two categorical assessments (baseline vs post-baseline category or grade, central vs local result, or site vs status), per group and optionally per parameter/visit.
candidate_config_options: matrix layout (row category x column category)
long layout (category rows by visit plus transition rows)
groups as row blocks or columns

templates.name: Response / incidence rate endpoint
templates.intended_use: Binary or categorical endpoint: category distribution, rate n (%) with confidence interval, optional between-group difference / odds ratio / test.
candidate_config_options: long format with cohort row blocks

templates.name: Time-to-event endpoint summary
templates.intended_use: Events / censored counts, Kaplan-Meier quantiles with CI, optional landmark rates, optional hazard ratio and test.
templates.not_for: Rates at a fixed time analysed as binary (TBL_RESPONSE_RATE).

templates.name: Continuous endpoint with between-group estimate
templates.intended_use: Descriptive statistics of a continuous endpoint (and its baseline / post-baseline components) followed by model-based or nonparametric estimates (LS mean, difference, Hodges-Lehmann) with CI and optional p-value.

templates.name: Subject record listing
templates.intended_use: Any subject-level data listing: one row per subject, per subject-event, per subject-visit (wide) or per subject-parameter-visit (long); configurable fields, stacked cells, group headers and column panels.
templates.not_for: Listings that do not list subjects (e.g. protocol criteria catalogs).

templates.name: Kaplan-Meier plot
templates.intended_use: Survival / event-free probability over time by group, censor marks, optional number-at-risk table.

templates.name: Group summary over time
templates.intended_use: A group-level summary statistic (mean +/- SD/SE, median, percentage) plotted against visit or time, one line per group or category; linear and/or log scale panels.
candidate_config_options: x axis as visit or continuous time

templates.name: Individual subject profiles
templates.intended_use: One line per subject over visit or time (spider plot, individual concentration-time), panels by group, optional reference lines.

templates.name: Box plot by group
templates.intended_use: Distribution of a continuous value by group (box, whiskers, optional points and mean marker).

templates.name: Waterfall plot
templates.intended_use: Per-subject best change from baseline as ordered bars, optional colour by response, reference lines.

templates.name: Tornado (butterfly) plot
templates.intended_use: Mirrored horizontal bars of subject percentages by term for two groups.
